query: How do I make veggie and hummus pinwheels?

goal.title: Make cucumber and hummus tortilla pinwheels
goal.description: Spread hummus over a flour tortilla, shave lengthwise cucumber ribbons onto it with a peeler, roll the tortilla tightly and slice it into rounds for a green plate.
goal.final_state: A green plate holds the sliced tortilla pinwheels; cucumber and hummus remain beside the cutting board.
procedure: Remove a tortilla from its bag and lay it flat on the board.
Open the hummus tub, peel off its seal and spread hummus across the tortilla with a blue spreader.
Shave thin cucumber ribbons directly over the hummus layer.
Roll the tortilla tightly around the cucumber.
Unsheath the knife, cut the roll into rounds and transfer the pieces to a green plate.
Lift the plate to show the pinwheels.

phases.description: The tortilla bag is opened, one tortilla is removed and laid flat on the cutting board.
The hummus lid and inner seal are removed. A blue spreader repeatedly scoops and smooths hummus over the tortilla surface.
One hand holds the cucumber while the other draws a peeler lengthwise, dropping successive thin ribbons across the tortilla. The cucumber and peeler are set aside.
Both hands curl and tuck the tortilla edge, rolling the hummus and cucumber into a tight cylinder that is steadied on the board.
The blue-handled knife is unsheathed. One hand steadies the roll while the other repeatedly cuts rounds, sets down the knife and transfers each piece toward the plate.
The green plate is lifted into view with the arranged tortilla rounds. The last source segment extends 0.1s beyond the actual video.
